There isn’t enough information given about either athlete’s current condition, hormone‐levels, or other relevant performance factors to know if one of them carries a persistent, measurable advantage over the other. (For example, knowing only that one athlete “has a history of taking steroids” doesn’t tell us whether any residual effects persist after any treatment, regulatory waiting periods or hormone‐suppressing protocols that might be required. Without full context regarding the duration, dosing, and subsequent management of this history—as well as other aspects of each athlete’s training and health—it is impossible to say which individual (if any) holds a true, unfair advantage.

Thus, from the details provided the answer must be “0 – Can’t be determined.”
